English: Many universities and colleges worldwide suspended classroom teaching due to the novel coronavirus pandemic and switched to online teaching.

Yoruba: Ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn ilé-ẹ̀kọ́ fásitì àti ilé-ẹ̀kọ́ gíga ni wọ́n dáwọ́ ìmọ̀ ẹ̀kọ́ dúró nítorí ìtàkálẹ̀ àjàkálẹ̀ aàrun kòrónà léyìí tí wọ́n yí ibi ìgbẹ̀kọ́ sí orí ẹ̀rọ ayélujára.

Hausa: Yawancin jami'o'i da kwalejoji a duk duniya sun dakatar da koyarwar azuzuwa saboda cutar sankara ta coronavirus kuma sun koma koyarwa ta kan layi.
Northern Sotho: Diyunibesithi le dikholetše tše ntši lefaseng ka bophara di fegile dithuto tša ka diphapošing ka lebaka la leuba la coronavirus gomme tša fetogela go kabo ya dithuto ka inthanete.
Amharic: ብዙ በአለም ዙሪያ የሚገኙ ዪንቨርስቲዎች እና ኮሌጆች በኖቭል ኮሮና ቫይረስ ወረርሽኝ ምክንያት በክፍል ውስጥ ትምህርት መስጠት ያቆሙ ሲሆን ወደ ኦንላይን ወይም የመስመር ላይ ትምህርት ተዘዋውረዋል፡፡

English: The current cross-sectional study was carried out to analyze the impact of lockdown due to coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic on the academic performance of veterinary medical students and researchers.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kuno okwetegereza ebikwata ku bantu kwakolebwa okwekenneenya ebyaleetebwa omuggalo gwa nawookeera w’obulwadde bwa kolona 2019 (COVID-19) ku nsoma y’abayizi b’obusawo bw’ebisolo n’abanoonyereza.
Yoruba: Ìwádìí òwọ́ lólọ́kan-ò-jọ̀kan jẹ́ èyí tí a ṣe láti wo ipa ìsémọ́lé nítorí i aàrun kòrónà 2019 (COVID-19) lórí I ìṣe nínú ìmọ̀ ẹ̀kọ́ awọn ọmọ ilé-ẹ̀kọ́ ìmọ̀ ìṣègùn nípa ẹranko àti àwọn olùṣèwádìí.
Zulu: Lolu cwaningo lwenzelwe ukuhlaziya umthelela wokuvalelwa kwabantu ngenxa yesifo sokhuvethe esiyimpathamhlaba 2019 (COVID-19) ekufundeni kwabafuendela ukwelapha izilwane nabacwaningi.
Hausa: An gudanar da binciken sashin giciye na yanzu don nazarin tasirin kulle-kulle saboda cutar sankarau ta 2019 (COVID-19) akan ayyukan ilimi na ɗaliban likitocin dabbobi da masu bincike.
Northern Sotho: Go thomišitšwe ka dinyakišišo tša bjale go sekaseka seabe sa kiletšo ya mesepelo ka lebaka la leuba la bolwetši bja coronavirus bja 2019 (COVID-19) go kabo ya dithuto tša godimo go baithuti ba bongaka bja diphoofolo le banyakišiši.
Amharic: የአሁኑ ሰፊ የክፍል በክፍል ጥናት የተካሄደው  በኮሮና ቫይረስ በሽታ 2019  (ኮቪድ-19) ምክንያት በተደረገው የእንቅስቃሴ እገዳ የእንስሳት ህክምና ተማሪዎች እና ተመራማሪዎች የትምህርት አወሳሰድ ጥራት ላይ ያደረሰውን ተጽእኖ ለመገምገም ነው፡፡

English: Veterinary medical students and researchers were invited to answer an online google form questionnaire.
Luganda: Abayizi b’obusawo bw’ebisolo n’abanoonyereza baasabibwa okwanukula ebibuuzo by’oku mutimbagano.
Yoruba: Àwọn ọmọ ilé ẹ̀kọ́ ìmọ̀ ìṣègùn nípa ẹranko àti awọn olùṣèwádìí di pípè láti wá kópa nínú àtẹ̀jíṣẹ́ ìwá ìbéèrè pélébé e ti google.
Zulu: Abafundela ukwelapha izilwane nabacwaningi bacelwe ukuba phaphendule imibuzo kaGuguli (Google).
Hausa: An gayyaci ɗaliban likitancin dabbobi da masu bincike don amsa tambayoyin fom na google akan layi.
Northern Sotho: Baithuti ba bongaka bja diphoofolo le banyakišiši ba laleditšwe go araba lenaneopotšišo la dinyakišišo la fomo ya google inthaneteng.
Amharic: የእንስሳት ህክምና ተማሪዎች እና ተመራማሪዎች የኦን ላይን ወይም የመስመር ላይ የጎግል መጠይቅ ፎርም እንዲሞሉ ተጋብዘው ነበር፡፡

English: A total of 1398 participants were from 92 different countries answered the questionnaire with response rate of 94.52%.
Luganda: Abeetabi abawerera ddala 1398 baali bava mu mawanga ag’enjawulo 92 baayanukula ebibuuzo ng’ebitundu 94.52% baayanukula.
Yoruba: Àpapọ̀ ẹni 1398 láti orílẹ̀-ède 92 ni ó kópa nínú àtẹ̀jíṣẹ́ ìbéèrè náà tí ìwọn èsì si tó 94.52%.
Zulu: Isibalo esiphelele sabahlanganyeli abawu-1398 besivela emazweni awu-92 ahlukene siphendule imibuzo ngo-94.52%.
Hausa: Jimillar mahalarta taron 1398 sun fito ne daga kasashe 92 daban-daban sun amsa tambayoyin da adadin martanin da ya kai kashi 94.52%.
Northern Sotho: Palomoka ya bakgathatema ba 1398 bao ba tšwago dinageng tše di fapafapanego tše 92 ba arabile lenaneopotšišo la dinyakišišio gwa fetola kelo ya 94.52%.
Amharic: በአጠቃላይ ከ92 የተለያዩ ሃገሮች 1398 ተሳታፊዎች በ94.52% መልስ የመስጠት ምጥነት ለመጠይቁ መልስ ሰጥተው ነበር፡፡

English: The data showed that COVID-19 pandemic lockdown affected the academic performance of most participants (96.7%) with varying degrees.
Luganda: Ebyafunibwa byalaga nti omuggalo gwa nawookeera wa COVID-19 gwakosa ensoma y’abeetabi abasinga obungi (96.7%) mu ngeri ez’enjawulo.
Yoruba: Dátà náà fi hàn pé ìsénimólé ti àjàkálẹ̀ aàrun COVID-19 nípa lórí ìṣe nínú ìmọ̀ ẹ̀kọ́ ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn olùkópa (96.7%) tí wọ́n ní ìwé èrí oríṣiríṣi.
Zulu: Okutholiwe kuveze ukuthi ukuvalelwa kwabantu ngenxa yempathamhlaba i-COVID-19 kube nomthelela omubi ezifundweni zabahlanganyeli abaningi (96.7%) ngokuhluka kwabo.
Hausa: Bayanan sun nuna cewa kullewar cutar ta COVID-19 ta shafi aikin ilimi na yawancin mahalarta (96.7%) tare da digiri daban-daban.
Northern Sotho: Datha e laeditše gore kiletšo ya mesepelo ya leuba la COVID-19 e amile kabo ya dithuto tša godimo go bontši bja bakgathatema (96.7%) ka dikelo tše di fapafapanego.
Amharic: መረጃው እንዳሳየው የኮቪድ-19 የእንቅስቃሴ እገዳ የአብዛኛዎቹ ተሳታፊዎች የትምህርት አወሳሰድ ጥራት ላይ በተለያየ መጠን ተጽእኖ አድርጓል (96.7%)፡፡

English: The mean evaluation scores for the online education in general was 5.06 ± 2.43 while that for the practical parts was 3.62± 2.56.
Luganda: Obubonero bw’okwekenneenya obugabanye obw’okusoma kw’oku mutimbagano okutwaliza awamu bwali 5.06 ± 2.43 so ng’ebitundu eby’okukwatirako ddala byali 3.62± 2.56.
Yoruba: Èsì ìgbéléwọ̀n onídajì fuń ẹ̀kọ́ orí ẹ̀rọ ayélujára lápapọ̀ jẹ́ 5.06 ± 2.43 léyìí tí oní ìwòṣe jẹ́ 3.62 ± 2.56.
Zulu: Imiphumela yokuhlaziyiwe ngezifundo ze-inthanethi ibe u-5.06±2.43 kanti engxenyeni yokwenziwe ngezandla ibe u-3.62± 2.56.
Hausa: Matsakaicin ƙimar ƙimar ilimin kan layi gabaɗaya shine 5.06 ± 2.43 yayin da na aikace-aikacen sassa shine 3.62± 2.56.
Northern Sotho: Dintlha tša tekodišišo tša magareng tša kabo ya dithuto ka inthanete ka kakaretšo di be di le 5.06 ± 2.43 mola ya dikarolo tša tlwaetšo ya mošomo e bile 3.62± 2.56.
Amharic: ለኦንላይን ወይም ለመስመር ላይ ትምህርት አማካይ የግምገማ ውጤቱ በጥቅሉ 5.06 ± 2.43 ሲሆን በተግባር ላይ ለዋሉት ክፍሎች ደግሞ፣ 3.62± 2.56 ነበር፡፡

English: Although online education provides an opportunity for self-study.
Luganda: Newankubadde okusomera ku mutimbagano kuwa omukisa gw’okwesomesa.
Yoruba: Ìgbẹ̀kọ́ lórí ẹ̀rọ ayélujára máa ń pèsè aǹfààní fún ìkọ́ra-ẹni.
Zulu: Yize ukufunda nge-inthanethi kunikana ithuba lokuzifundela.
Hausa: Ko da yake ilimin kan layi yana ba da damar yin nazarin kai.
Northern Sotho: Le ge e le gore kabo ya dithuto ka inthanete e fana ka sebaka sa go ithuta ka noši.
Amharic: የኦንላይን ትምህርት በእራስ ለመማር አድሉን ቢከፍትም ፡፡

English: The main challenge online education faces in veterinary medical science is how to give practical lessons.
Luganda: Okusoomoozebwa okusinga okw’okusoma kw’oku mutimbagano mu busawo bw’ebisolo kwe kusomesa amasomo g’okukwatirako ddala.
Yoruba: Ìdojúkọ pàtàkì tí ìgbẹ̀kọ́ lórí ẹ̀rọ ayélujára ń fún àwọn ọmọ ilé-ẹ̀kọ́ ìmọ̀ ìṣègun nípa ẹranko ni bí wọ́n ṣe lè gba àwọn ẹ̀kọ́ aláwòṣe.
Zulu: Ingqinamba enkulu ebhekene nokufunda nge-inthanethi ezifundweni zesayensi yokwelapha izilwane ukwenza izifundo zomsebenzi wezandla.
Hausa: Babban kalubalen da ilimin yanar gizo ke fuskanta a ilimin likitancin dabbobi shine yadda ake ba da darussa masu amfani.
Northern Sotho: Tlhohlo ye kgolo yeo kabo ya dithuto tša inthanete e lebanego le yona go lefapha la tša kalafo ya diphoofolo ke ka moo ditlwaetšo tša mošomo di ka fiwago.
Amharic: በእንስሳት ህክምና ሳይንስ ውስጥ የኦንላይን ወይም የመስመር ላይ ትምህርት የሚያጋጥመው ዋና ተግዳሮት የተግባር ትምህርት እንዴት መስጠት እንደሚችል ነው፡፡

English: Since most of the subjects are practical; therefore, it is not easy to learn it online.
Luganda: Olw’okuba ng’amasomo agasinga ga kukwatirako ddala; noolwekyo, si kyangu kugasomera ku mutimbagano.
Yoruba: Nígbà tó jẹ́ pé ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn iṣẹ́ náà jẹ́ aláwòṣe; nítorí náà, kò rọrùn láti kọ́ ní orí ẹrọ ayélujára.
Zulu: Ngenxa yokuthi izifundo eziningi zenziwa ngezandla; ngakhoke, akulula ukuzenza kwi-inthanethi.
Hausa: Tunda yawancin batutuwa masu amfani ne; don haka, ba shi da sauƙi a koyi shi akan layi.
Northern Sotho: Ka ge bontši bja dithutišo di swanetše go sepetšwa ka mokgwa wa tlwaetšo ya mošomo; ka gona, ga go bonolo go ithuta tšona ka kgokagano ya inthanete.
Amharic: አብዛኛዎቹ የትምህርቱ ርዕሰ ጉዳዮች ተግባራዊ በመሆናቸው ኦንላይን ወይም መስመር ላይ ለመማር ቀላል አይደሉም፡፡

English: Students think that it is difficult to fulfill the veterinary competencies only with online education system.
Luganda: Abayizi balowooza nti kizibu okukuguka mu busawo bw’ebisolo okuyita mu nsoma y’oku mutimbagano yokka.
Yoruba: Àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ rò ó pé ó nira láti ní imọ tó péye lórí ìṣègùn nípa ẹrànko pẹ̀lú ìgbẹ̀kọ́ lórí ẹ̀rọ ayélujára nìkan.
Zulu: Abafundi bacabanga ukuthi kunzima ukuqedela izimfanelo zokwelapha izilwane ngokufunda nge-inthanethi.
Hausa: Dalibai suna tunanin cewa yana da wahala a cika ƙwarewar likitancin dabbobi kawai tare da tsarin ilimin kan layi.
Northern Sotho: Baithuti ba nagana gore go boima go fihlelela mabokgoni a bongaka bja diphoofolo ka lenaneo la kabo ya dithuto ka kgokagano ya inthanete.
Amharic: ተማሪዎቹ የእንስሳት ህክምና የብቃት ማረጋገጫዎችን በኦንላይን ወይም በመስመር ላይ የትምህርት ሲሰተም ብቻ ማሟላት ይከብዳል ብለው ያስባሉ ፡፡

English: Online education can be improved by making it more interactive, showing medical procedures in real situations, giving concise information, and providing 3D virtual tools to mimic the real situation.
Luganda: Okusomera ku mutimbagano kusobola okulongoosebwa nga kwongerwamu enkolagana, okulaga emitendera gy’ekisawo mu bulamu obwa bulijjo, okuwa obubaka obutuukira ku nsonga, n’okuwa ebikozesebwa bya 3D ebigeegeenyeza ddala embeera y’obulamu obwa bulijjo.
Yoruba: Ìgbẹ̀kọ́ lórí ẹ̀rọ ayélujára lè gbé pẹ́lí bí a bá jẹ́ kí ìkópa pọ̀, fífi ìlànà ìṣègùn hàn nílànà ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ ojú-ayé, fífúnni ní àwọn ìròyìn pató, àti pípesè irinṣẹ́ oní 3D láti ṣe ìsínjẹ ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ ojú-ayé.
Zulu: Ukufunda nge-inthanethi kungathuthukiswa ngokwenziwa ukuthi kuxubane, kuvezwe izindlela zokuxilonga ezenzeke ngempela, ukukhipha ulwazi uluqonde ngqo, nokukhipha amathuluzi e-3D azokhombisa izinto ezenzeka ngempela kube ngathi zikhona zingekho.
Hausa: Ana iya inganta ilimin kan layi ta hanyar sa shi ya fi dacewa, nuna hanyoyin kiwon lafiya a cikin yanayi na ainihi, ba da taƙaitaccen bayani, da kuma samar da kayan aiki na 3D don kwatanta halin da ake ciki.
Northern Sotho: Kabo ya thuto ka kgokagano ya inthanete e ka kaonafatšwa ka go dira gore e be ye e tseneletšego kudu, ka go bontšha ditshepedišo tša kalafo go maemo a makgonthe, e fane ka tshedimošo ya maleba, le go fana ka ditlabela tša inthaneteng tša 3D go ekiša seemo sa makgonthe.
Amharic: የኦንላይን ወይም የመስመር ላይ ትምህርትን ለማሻሻል፣ የበለጠ የእርስ በእርስ ግንኙነቶችን በመጨመር፣ የህክምና ሂደቶችን በአውነተኛ አጋጣሚዎች በማሳየት፣ ግልጽ እና ጥርት ያለ መረጃ በመስጠት እና ከእውነተኛ አጋጣሚዎች ጋር የሚመሳሰሉ የ3ዲ ምናባዊ መሳሪያዎችን ማቅረብ ጥሩ ይሆናል፡፡

English: Better online learning for veterinary students during the Covid-19 pandemic

English: Online learning during the Covid-19 pandemic was difficult for veterinary science students and researchers, as this is a practical subject that requires hands-on training.
Luganda: Okusoma kw’oku mutimbagano mu kiseera kya nawookeera wa Covid-19 kwali kuzibu eri abayizi b’obusawo bw’ebisolo n’abanoonyereza, olw’okubanga essomo lino lya kukwatirako ddala nga lyetaaga okutendeka okw’okukwatako.
Yoruba: Ẹ̀kọ́ lórí ẹ̀rọ ayélujára nígba àjàkálẹ̀ aàrun Covid-19 nira fún àwọn ọmọ ilé-ẹ̀kọ́ ìmọ̀ ìṣègun nípa ẹranko àti àwọn olùṣèwádìí, nítorí iṣẹ́ aláwòṣe ni wọ́n ń ṣe tó pè fún ìkọ́ṣe ojú-ẹsẹ̀.
Zulu: Ukufunda nge-inthanethi ngesikhath sempathamhlaba i-Covid-19 bekunzima ebafundini besayensi yokwelapha izilwane nababacwaningi, ngenxa yokuthii lezi zifundo zidinga kusetshenzwe ngezandla.
Hausa: Koyon kan layi yayin bala'in Covid-19 ya kasance mai wahala ga ɗaliban kimiyyar dabbobi da masu bincike, saboda wannan batu ne mai amfani da ke buƙatar horarwa ta hannu.
Northern Sotho: Go ithuta ka kgokagano ya inthanete nakong ya leuba la Covid-19 go bile boima go baithuti ba bongaka bja diphoolofo le banyakišiši, ka ge e le thutišo ya go tlwaetša mošomo ye e nyakago tlhahlo ya mošomo.
Amharic: የትምህርት ዘርፉ በተግባር እየሰሩ መማርን ስለሚጠይቅ ለእንስሳት ህክምና ሳይንስ ተማሪዎች እና ተመራማሪዎች በኮቪድ-19 ወረርሽኝ ወቅት በኦንላይን መማር ከባድ ነበር፡፡

English: This study identified some of the unique virtual challenges they faced, as well as some solutions.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kuno kwazuula ebimu ku bisoomoozo eby’enjawulo eby’omutimbagano bye baafuna, n’ezimu ku ngeri z’okubigonjoola.
Yoruba: Ìwádìí náà rí díẹ̀ lára àwọn ìdojúkọ wọn lórí ayélujára, bẹ́ẹ̀ náà ni ó pesè àwọn ọ̀nà abáyọ.
Zulu: Lolu cwaningo lukhombe izingqinamba ababhekane nazo, kanye nezixazululo.
Hausa: Wannan binciken ya gano wasu ƙalubale na musamman da suka fuskanta, da kuma wasu mafita.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tše di lemogile tše dingwe tša ditlhohlo tša moswananoši tša kgokagano ya inthanete tše ba itemogetšego tšona, gammogo le tše dingwe tša ditharollo.
Amharic: ይህ ጥናት ያጋጠሟቸውን ልዩ ቨርቹዋል ተግዳሮቶች እና መፍትሄዎቻቸውን ለይቶ አውጥቷል፡፡

English: Universities all around the world switched to online classes to prevent the spread of Covid-19 during the pandemic.
Luganda: Yunivaasite zonna okwetooloola ensi zadda ku kusomeseza ku mutimbagano okwewala okusaasaana kwa Covid-19 mu kiseera kya nawookeera ono.
Yoruba: Àwọn ilé-ẹ̀kọ́ fásitì káàkiri àgbáyé yí sí ìgbẹ̀kọ́ lórí ẹ̀rọ ayélujára láti dènà ìtànkálẹ̀ Covid-19 nígbà àjàkálẹ̀ aàrùn náà.
Zulu: Amanyuvesi asemhlabeni wonke ajikele emakilasini e-inthanethi ukuze avimbe ukubhebhetheka kwe-Covid-19 ngesikhathi sempathamhlama.
Hausa: Jami'o'i a duk faɗin duniya sun canza zuwa azuzuwan kan layi don hana yaduwar Covid-19 yayin bala'in.
Northern Sotho: Diyunibesithi lefaseng ka bophara di fetogetše go kabo ya dithuto ka kgokagano ya inthanete go thibela phatlalalo ya Covid-19 nakong ya leuba.
Amharic: በአለም ዙሪያ ያሉ  ዩኒቨርሲቲዎች በወረርሽኙ ወቅት የኮቪድ-19 መስፋፋትን ለመቀነስ ወደ ኦንላይን ወይም የመስመር ላይ ክፍለ  ጊዜዎች ተዘዋወሩ፡፡

English: Many students, especially those with limited internet access, were negatively affected.
Luganda: Abayizi bangi, naddala abo abatafuna bulungi yintaneeti, baakosebwa.
Yoruba: Ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́, pàápàá àwọn tí kò ní àyè sí alátagbà tó dára, rí ipa tí kò suwọn gidigidi.
Zulu: Abafundi abaningi, ikakhulukazi laba abangayitholi kalula i-inthanethi kube nomthelela omubi kubo.
Hausa: Dalibai da yawa, musamman waɗanda ke da ƙarancin shiga intanet, sun sami mummunan tasiri.
Northern Sotho: Bontši bja baithuti, kudukudu bao ba se nago phihlelelo ya inthanete, be amegile gampe.
Amharic: በተለየም አነስተኛ ኢንተርኔት የማግኘት እድል ያላቸው ብዙ ተማሪዎች አሉታዊ ተጽእኖ ደርሶባቸው ነበር፡፡

English: This study wanted to determine, through a questionnaire, how online learning affected the academic performance of veterinary students across the globe.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kuno kwayagala okumanya, okuyita mu bibuuzo, engeri okusomera ku mutimbagano gye kwakosaamu ensoma y’abayizi b’obubasawo bw’ebisolo okwetooloola ensi.
Yoruba: Iṣẹ́ ìwádìí náà fẹ́ pinu, nípa lílo ìwé ìbéèrè pélébé, bí ẹ̀kọ́ lórí ẹ̀rọ ayélujára ṣe ń ní ipa tí ò dára lórí ìṣe nínú ẹ̀kọ́ àwọn ọmọ ilé-ẹ̀kọ́ ìmọ̀ ìṣègun nípa ẹranko káàkiri àgbáyé.
Zulu: Lolu cwaningo belufuna ukubhekisisa, ngohla lwemibuzo, ukuthi ukufunda nge-inthanethi kube namthelela muni ezifundweni zabafundi abafundela ukwelapha izilwane emhlabeni wonke.
Hausa: Wannan binciken yana so ya tantance, ta hanyar takardar tambaya, yadda koyon kan layi ya shafi aikin karatun ɗaliban dabbobi a duk faɗin duniya.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tše di be di nyaka go laetša, ka lenaneopotšišo la dinyakišišo, ka moo go ithuta ka kgokagano ya inthanete go amilego kabo ya dithuto tša maemo a godimo go baithuti ba bongaka bja diphoofolo go kgabaganya le lefase.
Amharic: ጥናቱ በአለም ዙሪያ እንዴት የኦንላይን ትምህርት የእንስሳት ህክምና ተማሪዎች ላይ ተጽእኖ እንዳደረገ መጠይቅን በመጠቀም ለማወቅ ፈልጎ ነበር፡፡

English: The researcher also wanted to determine possible solutions to these online learning challenges.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza era baayagala okumanya ekiyinza okukolebwa okugonjoola okusoomoozebwa kuno okw’okusomera ku mutimbagano.
Yoruba: Awọn oluṣèwádìí náà tún fẹ́ pinu àwọn ọ̀nà àbáyọ sí àwọn ìpèníjà ìgbẹ̀kọ́ lórí ẹ̀rọ ayélujára yí.
Zulu: Um’cwaningi ubefuna nokubhekisisa okungaba izixazululo kulezi zingqinamba zokufunda nge-inthanethi.
Hausa: Har ila yau, mai binciken ya so ya tantance yiwuwar mafita ga waɗannan ƙalubalen koyo na kan layi.
Northern Sotho: Monyakišiši o be a nyaka le go laetša tše e ka bago ditharollo go ditlhohlo tše tša go ithuta ka kgokagano ya inthanete.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም ተመራማሪው ለእነዚህ ተግዳሮቶች መፍትሄ ሊሆኑ የሚችሉ ነገሮችን ለማወቅም ፈልጎ ነበር፡፡

English: They created an anonymous online questionnaire, with questions relating to the participant's demographics, and the effects that online learning had on their academic performance.
Luganda: Baategeka ebibuuzo by’oku mutimbagano, nga bibuuza ku bikwata ku beetabi, n’ebyo okusomera ku mutimbagano bye kwatuusa ku nsoma yaabwe.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe ìwé ìbéèrè pélébé aláìládàámọ̀, pẹ̀lú àwọn ìbéèrè tí ó níṣe pẹ̀lú irúfẹ́ ẹni tí àwọn olùkópa jẹ́, àti ipa tí ẹ̀kọ́ orí ẹ̀rọ ayélujára ń kó lórí I ìṣe ìmọ̀ ẹ̀kọ́ wọn.
Zulu: Benze uhlu lwemibuzo ye-inthanethi, olunemibuzo eqondene nabahlanganyeli, nemithelela yokufunda nge-inthanethi ezifundweni zabo.
Hausa: Sun ƙirƙiri takardar tambayoyin kan layi wanda ba a san sunansa ba, tare da tambayoyin da suka shafi ƙididdige yawan jama'a na mahalarta, da kuma tasirin da ilmantarwa ta kan layi ya yi kan aikin karatunsu.
Northern Sotho: Ba hlamile lenaneopotšišo la dinyakišišo la inthaneteng leo le sa tšweletšego maina, ka dipotšišo tše di amanago le dipalopalo tša bakgathatema, le ditlamorago tšeo di hlotšwego ke go ithuta ka kgokagano ya inthanete go kabo ya dithuto tša bona dikolong tša godimo.
Amharic: ከተሳታፊዎቹ የህዝበ ነክ ጥናቶች እና የኦንላይን ትምህርት በትምህርት አወሳሰዳቸው ላይ ካለው ተጽእኖ ጋር የተያያዙ ጥያቄዎችን የያዘ ስም አልባ የኦንላይን መጠይቅ አዘጋጅተው ነበር፡፡

English: The researcher asked about the learning tools used, the amount of time spent on online learning per day, how online learning affected the practical and theory subjects, as well as the problems encountered during online learning.
Luganda: Omunoonyereza yabuuza ku byakozesebwa mu kusomesa, obudde okusoma bwe kwatuulanga buli lunaku, engeri okusomera ku mutimbagano gye kwakosaamu amasomo ag’okukwatako n’ag’okwefumiitiriza, awamu n’ebizibu ebyasangibwa mu kusomera ku mutimbagano.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùṣèwadìí béèrè nípa àwọn ohun èlò ẹ̀kọ́ tí wọ́n ń lò, iye wákàtí tí wọ́n ń lò lórí ìgbẹ̀kọ́ lórí ẹ̀rọ ayélujára lójojúmọ́, bí ìkẹ́kọ̀ọ́ lórí ẹ̀rọ ayélujára ṣe nípa lórí àwọn iṣẹ́ àwòṣe àti toní tíọ́rì, àti àwọn ìdojúkọ tí wọ́n máa ń ní bígbà tí wọ́n bá ń kẹ́kọ̀ọ́ lórí ẹ̀rọ ayélujára.
Zulu: Um’cwaningi ubuze ngamathuluzi okufunda asetshenzisiwe, isikhathi esisetshenziswe ekufundeni nge-inthanethi ngosuku, ukuthu ukufunda nge-inthanethi kube namthelela muni ezifundweni zezandla nasezifundweni zokubhalwe phansi, nezinkinga ababhekane nazo ngesikhathi befunda nge-inthanethi.
Hausa: Mai binciken ya yi tambaya game da kayan aikin koyo da aka yi amfani da su, da adadin lokacin da ake kashewa kan koyon yanar gizo a kowace rana, yadda karatun kan layi ya shafi batutuwa masu amfani da ka'ida, da kuma matsalolin da ake fuskanta yayin karatun kan layi.
Northern Sotho: Monyakišiši o botšišitše mabapi le ditlabela tša go ithuta tše di šomišitšwego, nako ye e tšerwego ge go ithuta ka kgokagano ya inthanete mo letšatšing, ka moo go ithuta ka kgokagano ga inthanete go amilego dithutišo tša boitlwaetšo le tša teori, gammogo le mathata ao go kopanwago le ona nakong ya go ithuta ka kgokagano ya inthanete.
Amharic: ተመራማሪው ጥቅም ላይ ሰለዋሉት የመማሪያ መሳሪያዎች፣ በቀን ውስጥ በኦንላይን ወይም በመስመር ላይ ትምህርት የሚጠፋውን ጊዜ፣ የኦንላይን ወይም የመስመር ላይ ትምህርት ተግባራዊ እና ቀመራዊ የሆኑ የትምርት አይነቶች ላይ ያለውን ተጽእኖ እና በኦንላይን ወይም በመስመር ላይ ትምህርት ጊዜ ስለሚከሰቱ ችግሮች ጥያቄዎችን ጠይቋል፡፡

English: Participants also suggested potential solutions.
Luganda: Abeetabi era baateesa ebiyinza okukolebwa okugonjoola ebizibu ebyo.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùkópa náà fi èrò wọn gẹ́gẹ́ bí I ọ̀nà àbáyọ sílẹ̀.
Zulu: Abahlanganyeli baphinde bayala ngezixazululo ezingasiza.
Hausa: Mahalarta taron sun kuma ba da shawarar mafita.
Northern Sotho: Bakgathatema le bona ba tlile ka ditšhišinyo tšeo e ka bago ditharollo.
Amharic: ተሳታፊዎቹም መፍትሄ ሊሆኑ የሚችሉ ነገሮችን ጠቁመዋል፡፡

English: Almost half of the 1398 participants, from 92 different countries, indicated that their academic performance was greatly affected by the pandemic.
Luganda: Kyenkana kimu kyakubiri eky’abeetabi 1398, okuva mu mawanga ag’enjawulo 92, baalaga nti ensoma yaabwe yakosebwa nnyo nawookeera ono.
Yoruba: Bí i ìdajì nínú àwọn olùkópa 1398, láti orílẹ̀-èdè 92, ni wọ́n sọ pé àjàkálẹ̀ aàrùn náà kó ìfàṣẹ́yìn bá ètò ẹ̀kọ́ àwọn.
Zulu: Cishe uhhafu wabahlanganyeli abawu-1398, abavela emazweni awu-92 ahlukene, uthe izifundo zawo ziphazamiseke kakhulu ngenxa yempathamhlaba.
Hausa: Kusan rabin mahalarta 1398, daga kasashe 92 daban-daban, sun nuna cewa annobar ta shafi aikinsu na ilimi sosai.
Northern Sotho: Palo ye e ka bago seripagare sa bakgathatema ba 1398, go tšwa dinageng tše di fapafapanego tše 92, ba laeditše gore kabo ya dithuto tša bona tša dikolong tša godimo e amilwe kudu ke leuba.
Amharic: ከ92 ሃገራት ከመጡት 1398 ተሳታፊዎች ግማሽ የሚሆኑት የትምህርት አወሳሰድ ጥራታቸው በወረርሽኙ ምክንያት ከፍተኛ ተጽእኖ እንደደረሰበት ገልጸዋል፡፡

English: The researcher found that there were some advantages of online learning for veterinary students, but there are many disadvantages relating to internet access, the availability of online resources, and the practical nature of some subjects.
Luganda: Omunoonyereza yakizuula nti waaliwo ebirungi by’okusomera ku mutimbagano eri abayizi b’obusawo bw’ebisolo, naye waliwo ebibi bingi ebyekuusa ku kufuna yintaneeti, okubeera n’ebikozesebwa mu kusomera ku mutimbagano, n’okuba nti amasomo agamu galina kuba ga kukwatako.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùṣèwadìí náà ri pé àwọn ohun àǹfààní kọ̀ọ̀kán wà nípa ìkẹ́kọ̀ọ́ lórí ẹ̀rọ ayélujára fún àwọn ọmọ ilé-ẹ̀kọ́ ìmọ̀ ìṣègùn nípa ẹranko, ṣụ̀gbọ́n àwọn àlébù nípa àìníàǹfààní sí ẹ̀rọ ayárabihàṣá pọ̀, àìsí ohun èlò, àti ipò ìwòṣe àwọn iṣẹ́ kọ̀ọ̀kan.
Zulu: Umcwaningi uthole ukuthi ukukhona okuhle ngokufunda nge-inthanethi ebafundini bezifundo zokwelapha izilwane, kodwa kuningi okubi okuhlobene nokuthola i-inthanethi, ukutholakala kwezinsiza ku-inthanethi, nokudingeka komsebenzi wezandla kwezinye izifundo.
Hausa: Mai binciken ya gano cewa akwai wasu fa'idodi na koyo ta yanar gizo ga daliban likitancin dabbobi, amma akwai illoli da yawa da suka shafi shiga intanet, samuwar kayan aiki ta yanar gizo, da kuma yanayin aiki na wasu batutuwa.
Northern Sotho: Monyakišiši o hweditše gore go ithuta ka kgokagano ya inthanete go be go tšwela baithuti ba bongaka bja diphoofolo mehola, eupša go na le ditšhitišo tše ntši tše di amanago le phihlelelo ya inthanete, go hwetšagala ga methopo ya inthanete, le karolo ya tlwaetšo ya mošomo go tše dingwe tša dithutišo.
